verdict.rationale: Featurebase advertises general third-party integrations ('connect with your favorite tools in just a few clicks') plus webhooks and an API/SDK for custom connections, which could plausibly link to support, sales, or chat tools. However, no specific named integrations (e.g., Intercom, Zendesk, Slack, Salesforce) are evidenced, only generic marketing language. Missing for 10: named integrations with specific support/sales/chat platforms, documentation of how feedback syncs bidirectionally with those tools, and independent confirmation of these integrations in use.
